audit.why: Content whys[] correctly frame early Janna advantage (mobility dodges unseeded Zyra) versus Zyra taking over from level 3 through seeded plants/E root/R combo, matching the 53% win rate. packet.defects flags an apparent contradiction between 53% win rate and a 5/7-Zyra chart, but a lane-phase chart and a full-game win rate aren't the same measurement (Janna's kit is disengage-and-scale, recovering value after a losing early-mid lane) — left the chart split as-is since content and packet levelChart already agree.
Spikes correctly name level 2 (pre-seed engage window), level 6 (Stranglethorns into Grasping Roots combo), first item (Liandry's zone poke peak), late (Monsoon scatters her setup).

audit.whatIsWrong: Zyra (she/her) is misgendered as 'his'/'him' in loading, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[11].t per lintFindings. Full-layer phases[N].side disagrees with content win[N] on all 7 rows: rows 0/1 say Zyra where win[]=Janna, and rows 2-6 say Skill where win[]=Zyra, with generic why text not naming her actual kit.
audit.why: Riot's kit text confirms Zyra female. Her E Grasping Roots (11s CD) roots and grounds, Q Deadly Spines (7/6.5/6/5.5/5s CD) zones with seeded plants, R Stranglethorns knocks up — all live from level 3 onward per content.whys, matching the win[] flip.
